The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] established a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Sovereignty Dawn]] territory of the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. It was used to support their operations in the system.
